config._comment: Operational configuration — areas included in food-cost/server metrics, service periods, matching tolerances. Edit here, not in code.

includedAreas._comment: Allowlist. A check counts only if it has a table AND its service area (preferred) or revenue center is listed. Bar, takeout, delivery, online ordering are excluded by omission.

servicePeriods._comment: Toast does not expose a reliable daypart on orders; these configurable defaults apply (local restaurant time). Lunch: before cutoff; Dinner: cutoff and later.

baseline._comment: Food-cost baseline: same weekday + same service period across the prior N weeks, weighted by dollars.

opentableMatch._comment: Automatic matching window: OpenTable reservation/seating time vs Toast check-open time. Candidates outside the window are never suggested. Patio table numbers are unreliable (guests self-seat), so patio matching leans on time/party/area evidence instead.

commission._comment: Per CONVERTED COVER, not per table. Active only in the pilot window; program currently inactive.
